name: Squat
description: Brace hard, descend with control, and drive up through mid-foot.

name: Front Squat
description: Rack bar on shoulders, keep chest tall, sit between hips, and drive up.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Hold weight at chest, sit back between knees, and maintain upright torso.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rear foot elevated, descend straight down, and drive through front heel.

name: Bench Press
description: Set upper back tight, lower to lower chest, and press with a stable bar path.

name: Incline Bench Press
description: Press from incline bench, keeping elbows under wrists and controlled descent.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
description: Hands inside shoulder width, elbows tucked, press bar upward.

name: Barbell Row
description: Hinge and row the bar to lower ribs while keeping torso braced.

name: Pendlay Row
description: Explosive row from floor each rep, keep torso parallel and controlled.

name: Overhead Press
description: Press bar overhead in a vertical line while maintaining full-body tension.

name: Arnold Press
description: Rotate dumbbells as you press overhead for full shoulder activation.

name: Deadlift
description: Pull slack out, push the floor away, and lock out with hips and lats engaged.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hinge at hips, keep bar close, feel stretch in hamstrings, then stand tall.

name: Sumo Deadlift
description: Wide stance, push knees out, maintain upright torso, and pull bar to lockout.

name: Pull Up
description: Pull chest toward bar with an overhand grip, then lower under control.

name: Chin Up
description: Use an underhand grip, pull to the bar, and control the descent.

name: Dips
description: Descend under control with shoulders stable, then press back to lockout.

name: Face Pull
description: Pull rope toward face with elbows high, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Lateral Raise
description: Raise arms to sides with slight bend in elbows, controlled motion.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Curl dumbbells with neutral grip, keep elbows tucked.

name: Triceps Pushdown
description: Press cable down while keeping elbows pinned to sides.

name: Plank
description: Maintain straight line from head to heels, brace abs and glutes.

name: Side Plank
description: Support body on one arm while maintaining straight alignment.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Lift legs while hanging, control descent, brace core throughout.

name: Hip Thrust
description: Drive hips up with bar across pelvis, squeeze glutes at top.

name: Leg Press
description: Press platform away with feet shoulder-width, keep lower back on pad.

name: Calf Raise
description: Raise heels off floor slowly, control lowering.

name: Farmer Carry
description: Walk while holding heavy weights at sides, keep core braced.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Hinge at hips to swing kettlebell forward explosively.

name: Row · Erg
description: Drive with the legs, swing the hips, finish with the arms. Distance logged in metres.
